key_developments.event: Bruno of Cologne founds the Grande Chartreuse.
Customs codified by Prior Guigo as the Consuetudines Cartusiae.

_quarry.description: An eremitic order founded by Bruno of Cologne in 1084 at the Grande Chartreuse in the French Alps. Each monk lives in a private cell within a shared monastery — a hybrid of hermit and communal life. The Carthusians never underwent the reform-decay cycle of other orders (their motto: Nunquam reformata quia nunquam deformata — 'never reformed because never deformed') and remained small and rigorous through the period.
